name: Secure Admin Portal
description: A pattern for privileged administrative interfaces that manage critical systems, user accounts, or sensitive data. Requires enhanced security controls including strong authentication, privileged access management, comprehensive audit logging, and network-level restrictions beyond standard application security.
whenToUse: Administrative interfaces for managing production systems and infrastructure
Portals for managing citizen data, user accounts, or access permissions
Interfaces for configuring security policies, firewall rules, or encryption keys
Back-office tools where actions have significant impact if performed incorrectly or maliciously
Systems requiring separation of duties and four-eyes approval for critical operations
whenNotToUse: Standard internal applications without elevated privileges or critical operations
Self-service portals where users manage only their own data
Public-facing services where all users have equivalent access levels
Development and testing tools that do not access production data

typicalComponents.name: Privileged Access Gateway
typicalComponents.purpose: Broker and record all privileged sessions with just-in-time access
typicalComponents.technology: CyberArk, Azure PIM, or AWS SSO with session recording

typicalComponents.name: Admin Web Application
typicalComponents.purpose: Provide the administrative user interface with role-based views
typicalComponents.technology: React or Angular with server-side rendering

typicalComponents.name: Audit Log Store
typicalComponents.purpose: Immutably record all administrative actions for forensic analysis
typicalComponents.technology: CloudTrail, Azure Activity Log, or Cloud Audit Logs

typicalComponents.name: Approval Workflow
typicalComponents.purpose: Enforce multi-person approval for critical or destructive operations
typicalComponents.technology: Custom workflow engine or ServiceNow integration

typicalComponents.name: Network Restriction Layer
typicalComponents.purpose: Limit access to admin portal from approved networks only
typicalComponents.technology: VPN, Private Link, or IP allowlisting

securityControls: Enforce multi-factor authentication with hardware tokens for all admin access
Implement just-in-time privileged access with time-limited session elevation
Restrict network access to admin portal from approved corporate networks or VPN only
Implement comprehensive audit logging of all actions with tamper-proof storage
Enforce separation of duties — no single user can both request and approve critical changes
Implement session recording for all privileged access sessions
Apply break-glass procedures for emergency access with post-incident review
Implement anomaly detection for unusual admin behaviour patterns
resilienceConsiderations: Admin portals typically have lower availability requirements than citizen-facing services
Implement break-glass procedures for emergency access if primary auth is unavailable
Ensure audit log storage is independent of the admin portal for forensic integrity
Design for graceful degradation — read-only mode if approval workflow is unavailable
Maintain offline runbooks for critical operations if the admin portal is inaccessible
costConsiderations: Privileged access management solutions carry significant licensing costs
Hardware MFA tokens have per-device procurement and replacement costs
Audit log storage costs for long-term retention (typically 7+ years for compliance)
Lower user count means compute costs are minimal
Security assessment and penetration testing costs for privileged interfaces
Consider the cost of a security breach through an admin portal versus protection investment
operationalConsiderations: User onboarding and offboarding procedures for admin access must be rigorous
Regular access reviews to ensure only current role-holders retain admin privileges
Incident response procedures specific to compromised admin credentials
Regular review of audit logs for suspicious activity patterns
Training for admin users on security procedures and acceptable use
Periodic penetration testing focused on privilege escalation and access bypass

services.name: AWS IAM Identity Center
services.purpose: Centralised admin access with MFA enforcement

services.name: AWS CloudTrail
services.purpose: Immutable audit logging of all API actions

services.name: AWS PrivateLink
services.purpose: Private network access to admin interfaces

services.name: Azure Bastion
services.purpose: Secure admin access without public IP exposure

services.name: Access Approval
services.purpose: Require approval before Google support access

questionsToAsk: How many users require admin access and what are their specific roles?
What critical operations require multi-person approval?
What is the audit log retention requirement for compliance?
Is there an existing privileged access management solution in the organisation?
What network restrictions can be applied without impacting legitimate admin workflows?
What is the break-glass procedure for emergency access outside normal channels?
commonMistakes: Exposing admin portals to the public internet without network-level restrictions
Using the same authentication strength for admin access as standard user access
Not implementing audit logging or storing logs in a location admins can modify
Granting permanent admin access instead of just-in-time elevation
Not conducting regular access reviews, leaving stale admin accounts active
